hints: A border is a proper prefix that is also a suffix.
The prefix-function value at the final character gives the longest border length.
Follow prefix-function links repeatedly to find every shorter border.
analogy: The longest matching end-cap contains all smaller border lengths in its own prefix chain.
example: For 'abcab', border length 2 is 'ab'; length 5 is excluded because a border must be proper.
algorithm: Compute KMP prefix function. Start with pi[n-1], output that length, then repeatedly replace it with pi[length-1] until zero; sort lengths ascending if required.
correctness: Every border of the full string is a border of its longest border, so following the prefix-function chain visits all proper borders.
